title: Giving considered experience a future

captions.physics: Establishing arrangements for passing experience on
captions.energy: Sharing a light found through reflection
captions.emotions: Confidence in a steady shared foundation

meaning: Sharing considered experience can inspire you when dependable participation brings a sense of steady support for your shared purpose.
text: Understanding you have found can have a continuation on which others can rely. The Hermit in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to reflect on experience and offer its light without requiring everyone to repeat your steps. The Emperor in the physical position describes concrete shared actions: allocating responsibility, arranging transmission and fulfilling promises. The Emperor in emotions has another role, quiet confidence in a steady foundation. It feels good that your involvement helps a larger endeavour rest on understandable arrangements, making knowledge available beyond a chance personal meeting with you.

For example, after several years of open walks, you help establish a way to pass experience to new guides. Together, you decide who introduces the route, where materials are kept and how questions can be asked. **Considered experience gains a continuation through dependable accessibility.** You greet another team’s first independent walk with quiet confidence: people have support for a path of their own. Something important survives your absence on a weekend, while shared work helps new participants encounter the city.

The difficulty may arise if transmission arrangements require repeating your exact sequence. A new guide knows the material but cannot choose an approach suitable for the group. The wish to share and a feeling of dependability remain supportive. Action benefits from distinguishing an essential foundation from a personal method, allowing others to lead people along their own accessible path.
